status: additive n=32 fixed-map-time temporal-step control; exploratory, no quality threshold

candidate_prediction.method: tools.predict_amr_grid_candidates using analytic g(y)g(z), strict thresholds 0.01<sensor<1.1, and one periodic six-face-neighbor buffer layer
candidate_prediction.status: prediction only; actual selected count must match captured Foundation log and mapped topology

temporal_comparison.interpretation: Compares two discrete pre-map evolutions sampled at the same first-map time. It is not an isolated formal order study because changing delta_t also changes the number of steps and refineInterval.

new_measurement.preMap: write C, V, U, p, face centers/areas/owners/neighbours/phi/Uf immediately before mesh_.update() at t=0.002
new_measurement.mapped: same fields immediately after mesh_.update() at t=0.002
new_measurement.temporal_control: Repeat n=32 first-map capture at delta_t=0.0005 with refineInterval=4 so first adaptation still occurs at t=0.002; mapped snapshot same time, later stages at t=0.0025.

acceptance.measurement_gate: Exactly six named stage events; preMap has 32768 cells and mapped has 118784 cells, both at t=0.002; solver-stage snapshots are at t=0.0025; solver exits zero with End; LD_DEBUG confirms instrumented library load.
analysis: Compare mapped cell values against piecewise-constant injection from this run's preMap field using geometrically containing uniform-grid parents.
Check parent-child volume closure, cell counts, levels, domain integral and weighted relative L2/max absolute differences.

Compare stored parent and mapped child DOFs with the analytic finite-volume average of the smooth MMS using the independently quadrature-checked closed form; label this a DOF diagnostic, not an assumed OpenFOAM storage definition or a continuous reconstruction norm.
Decompose point-sample error algebraically into inherited parent-center error, exact-reference center shift, and cross term; do not label this finite-volume truncation error.
Compare mapped and exact-MMS cell-center samples only as point-sample diagnostics; keep finite-volume cell-average accuracy claims separate.
Compare preMap and mapped face flux/divergence only after matching geometric face relationships; no assumption that face indices persist across remapping.
acceptance.quality_gate: None. The run is a mapping-mechanism diagnostic, not a convergence or solver-quality pass/fail.

limits: The candidate count is predicted independently from the structured-grid analytic sensor and source-inspected periodic face-neighbor buffering; the actual Foundation selection log and captured mapped count must confirm it.
A single n=32 event supplements but does not establish an AMR convergence study or general guarantee.
The packaged solver stack is not proven source-equivalent; only the instrumented incompressibleFluid module is compiled from the pinned source commit and library load is recorded.
The trigger time matches the prior n=16 first-refinement diagnostic and is therefore exploratory, not blinded or preregistered before all prior observations.

This is a fixed-first-map-time temporal-step control, not a formal temporal convergence order study; halving delta_t doubles the pre-map steps and refineInterval is adjusted to preserve the adaptation time.
